title: My Favourite Toy
text:
My name is Tom. I have a red car. It is my favourite toy. I play with it in the garden every day.

My sister has a doll. She calls it Anna. Anna has long hair and a pink dress. We play together on Sunday.

questions.text: What is the name of the doll?
Where does Tom probably play with his car?
How does Tom's sister probably feel when she plays with Anna?

vocabulary.definition: a place with grass and flowers outside a house
a toy that looks like a small person
a piece of clothing for girls and women that covers the body

paragraph_translations: Nazywam się Tom. Mam czerwony samochód. To mój ulubiony zabawka. Bawię się nim w ogrodzie każdego dnia.
Moja siostra ma lalkę. Nazywa ją Anna. Anna ma długie włosy i różową sukienkę. Bawimy się razem w niedzielę.
